respiration.instructional: Gas exchange means diffusion of oxygen and carbon dioxide across a respiratory surface. A large surface area and a short diffusion distance increase the rate of gas exchange. Blood transports oxygen from the lungs to tissues and returns carbon dioxide to the lungs.
